The IEEE standards mapped at category level in the Eticas taxonomy are:

1. IEEE Std 7001-2021 - covers transparency of autonomous systems.
2. IEEE Std 7002-2022 - covers data privacy process.
3. IEEE Std 7003-2024 - covers algorithmic bias considerations.
4. IEEE Std 2894-2024 - covers architectural framework for explainable AI.

The first three are placed in the compliance tier, while the last one is placed in the reference tier.
